questions.question: What further evolution would grow from this companion’s established identity, and how would the player reach it?

description:
The existing Fighting stage after Makuhita, reached at level 24. It retains the line’s physical strength, disruption and willingness to stand its ground; its larger body changes how a familiar helper occupies a place. A further custom stage is intended but has no settled name, appearance or typing.

Proposed local use: a willing companion can brace a load while people reposition it, with a clear cue to release. Its size makes narrow stairs, fragile floorboards and crowded rooms real staging constraints. Human cooperation matters as much as strength; Hariyama should not become an unlimited replacement for porters or solve every locked route by pushing. Maku’s particular care with bottles remains his own history.
